# MaxMind DB Reader (PHP)

Vendored copy of maxmind/MaxMind-DB-Reader-php v1.12.0 (src/MaxMind/Db), Apache License 2.0 (see LICENSE).
Used by application/libraries/City_geo.php to read the DB-IP "IP to City Lite" database
(storage/geo/dbip-city-lite.mmdb), which uses the MaxMind DB file format.
Bundled here so the VM needs no Composer install.
